text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The frenzy and adoration belonged solely 
to the one true monarch ruling the turf. 
Orfevre believed they were meant for her 
alone. However—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> and Venus Park. Those two names, having 
stolen the crowd's hearts, ignited a fire 
in Orfevre's soul.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There need only be one throne of the King 
that people look up to— Orfevre informs <chrname> 
that she will personally strike them down 
at the Representative Exchange Race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Faced with those terrifyingly intense 
words, <chrname> and the others could only silently 
take them in.
